# Capture

> Capture helps established Nigerian businesses stop losing revenue from slow or missed customer responses on their existing channels.

Capture is a revenue-execution platform for established, already-trading Nigerian businesses (Lagos-focused), made up of three independent products:

- **Engage** — responds instantly to Instagram DM enquiries, qualifies them (name, product, timing), and escalates anything sensitive (price negotiation, complaints, unusual requests) to a person instead of guessing. WhatsApp ingestion is planned but not yet available. New customers get a 7-day free trial that starts with a baseline built from their last 30 days of real conversations.
- **Find** — reads a business's existing WhatsApp conversations and prices the revenue sitting in enquiries that went unanswered or unfollowed-up. Free, and does not require Engage.
- **Recover** — ranks a business's dormant leads and past customers, times outreach to each opportunity, and stops automatically the moment someone replies. Independent of Engage, but requires Find's report first — Find is what brings a business's conversation history in.

Engage and Find are each independently useful without the other. Recover is the one exception: it needs Find's conversation-history report as a prerequisite before it can function.

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://capture.com.ng/ — product overview, Engage pricing, and how Engage works
- Find (free revenue-leak assessment): https://capture.com.ng/find
- Recover (dormant-lead recovery, priced by history window): https://capture.com.ng/recover
- Start a trial: https://capture.com.ng/signup
- Terms & Privacy: https://capture.com.ng/privacy
- Data Deletion Instructions: https://capture.com.ng/data-deletion

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Capture is based in Lagos, Nigeria, and built for established businesses already receiving customer enquiries — not pre-launch or idea-stage businesses.
- Engage pricing (homepage) and Recover pricing (/recover) are both live, admin-editable figures — read them fresh from the page rather than caching a number, since they can change.
- URLs under /dashboard, /admin, /onboarding, /report/, and /upload/ are authenticated or per-business token links, not general product documentation — they are excluded from crawling (see /robots.txt) and should not be cited as public pages.
